previous_notes.text: Patient presented with elevated PSA of 3.8 ng/mL. Digital rectal examination was unremarkable. Ultrasound-guided biopsy was performed, revealing Gleason 3+3 adenocarcinoma. Referred to urology for further management discussion.

pathology_report:
Biopsy timepoint 1 (Aug 2023): The submitted prostate tissue demonstrates acinar growth pattern with Gleason score 3+3, corresponding to ISUP grade group 1. A cribriform pattern is present within the lesion. Perineural invasion is not identified. The tumour is located in the transition zone at the apex.

Summary: Histological findings across timepoints show stable Gleason 3+3 disease with persistent cribriform architecture.

AI-predicted ISUP grade group (digital pathology): grade group 3.
